NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, November 4 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 4 · 11 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 3, 4:31 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, November 4 DraftKings main slate at 56.9 DraftKings points for $12,300. Cade Cunningham (DET, 47.1, $9,300) and Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK, 47.0, $8,300) are next.

Josh Hart (NYK) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.75 projected points per $1,000 at $6,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 3, 4:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
